get.description: Orders, state distribution and license types are filtered by order creation time; financial trends, payout components and top assets use journal time. Account balances remain current snapshots. Continuous trend buckets include zero-activity dates and cover the entire range in at most 90 equal-day buckets. Exact integer aggregates are decimal strings. Bounded ranges include the immediately preceding equal-length comparison period. See docs/analytics.md.
